title: wt doctor|sync doctor --json
description: What a doctor found, one record per finding. Printed by `wt doctor --json` and `wt sync doctor --json` as the only thing on stdout; the command exits 1 when a record anywhere is fail. It changes nothing. Schema 1: fields may be added and enumerations may gain values; nothing is renamed or removed. See docs/json.md.

schema.description: The major version: a new one only for a change that breaks readers.

schemaVersion.description: The full semantic version of this schema that the output follows: minor for an added field or enumeration value, patch for wording.

checks.description: The findings of this run. With repos, only those of your roots and profiles, and a repos.select record when the selection failed.

repos.description: With --all, --roots or --profile: every repository the selection names, empty when it names none. Null without them.

path.description: The absolute path of the repository, as the selection names it.

checks.description: wt doctor's findings there, without roots and profiles, and wt sync doctor's where trunk declares wt sync.

id.description: Which check, dotted and stable: config.parse, tools.git, sync.declaration. Several records may carry one id, such as one per worktree.

status.description: ok; warn: worth knowing, never a failure; fail: breaks wt here; unknown: wt could not tell, for want of an answer.

detail.description: What was found, on one line, for a person. Its wording may change.

fix.description: A command that fixes it, to run in that repository; null when wt knows none.
